name: GamerHoard
purpose: Biblioteca local de videojuegos: catálogo RAWG opcional, seguimiento, DLC, estadísticas e importación de Steam.
notes: No web app or background service. The MCP server reads and writes one local JSON file in ~/.gamerhoard/library.json by default. RAWG_API_KEY only enables online catalog search; Steam import accepts a key per call and never saves it.
